measurements.how_measured: counted distinct ink colors across all marks inside the thin border versus the paper ground
measurements.statement: Inside the inner frame only black ink and a single saturated red-orange hue appear on an off-white ground

measurements.how_measured: compared stroke thickness to counter and stem width on the large upper red form and the two smaller black E-forms
measurements.statement: Letter-like forms are heavy-weight, wide, geometric sans with near-zero stroke contrast and tight construction, all rotated together off-vertical

measurements.how_measured: traced long red spine from lower-left to upper-right against the vertical border edge and estimated angle and extent
measurements.statement: All major elongated forms share a common diagonal tilted about 20 degrees off vertical rising to the right, spanning almost the full inner-frame height

measurements.how_measured: visually divided inner frame into dense overlapping center versus plain right and bottom zones
measurements.statement: About half of the inner framed area remains empty off-white, concentrated on the right side and below the dense overlap

measurements.how_measured: compared border extents to page edges left-right and top-bottom
measurements.statement: A thin black orthogonal rule encloses the composition centered on the page with a larger blank margin below than above
measurements.value: frame width ~65% of page, height ~78% of page

hypotheses.statement: Hierarchy comes from scale plus color overlap: the huge red form dominates, black solids anchor the middle and lower zones
Tension comes from the diagonal cluster colliding with the thin orthogonal frame, making the static border feel charged
Mood is urgent and constructivist from severe palette restraint and heavy geometry set against abundant white breathing room

relations.rule: Limit any new layout to one saturated hue plus black on light ground, using the hue only for the largest shape and thin accent lines covering <15% of area
Rotate the whole content group 15-25 degrees off the container vertical while keeping the container orthogonal
Create hierarchy by overlapping large-scale color forms in the upper-center with smaller heavy solids offset below, not by linear reading order

fragile_if_changed: If the shared diagonal tilt were straightened to vertical and horizontal, the collision with the orthogonal frame and sense of forward thrust would collapse into static stacking.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'red-black marks area'
